conviction_note: First quarter with Kloeckner consolidated (about 62% owned, since 2026-06-03). Abs move set at 8%, above the 6.87% median reaction, because this is the first combined print and management promised 'additional color on the combined company'. p_up is 45. Kloeckner's own run-rate and the US price path point up. Pointing down: the company's pro forma shows the deal heavily dilutive to GAAP EPS, the aggregator bars ($0.70 and $1.16) disagree, 6 of the last 7 prints fell, and the stock is +10% in 5 days with no catalyst found. Both numbers are capped small because the bar is disputed.
bar: DISPUTED, so every size is capped small. Zacks/Earnings Whispers carry Q1 FY27 EPS $1.16 on revenue $885.9m (https://beta.earningswhispers.com/go/w/WS, page showing spot $39.12, so current; Zacks Q1'27 $1.16/$885.9m per search snippet of https://www.benzinga.com/quote/WS/earnings-forecasts). FMP-type previews carry EPS $0.70 on revenue $950.4m and FY27 sales $3.71bn (search snippet, businesswire/FMP cluster, undated). Both revenue figures are standalone WS ($929m last quarter) and exclude Kloeckner (EUR 1.69bn sales in its Q2 2026), so the reported revenue will be about 3x every aggregator bar. That revenue 'beat' is mechanical. The three covering analysts' combined models are not public. print_vs_bar_pct is measured against $0.70 EPS, my rough combined estimate being ~$0.55-0.75.
positioning_check: Short interest 1,764,145 shares, 3.56% of float, 6.2 days to cover, +10.0% vs the prior report, settlement 2026-09-15 (https://www.marketbeat.com/stocks/NYSE/WS/short-interest/). Not crowded, so it gives no squeeze reason to shrink negatives. No usable option chain: OI 121, ATM spread 100% of mid, skew null, put/call OI 0.36. The market has made no directional statement. Tape: +10.1% over 5 days and +10.3% over 20 days into the print, 19% below the 52-week high. An AAII note dated 2026-10-06 found no catalyst for the rise (https://www.aaii.com/investingideas/article/538345-why-worthington-steel-inc8217s-ws-stock-is-up-547). Reaction history: 1 of 7 prints up, median |move| 6.87%. The last two prints fell -7.04% (EW calls that one a beat) and -14.91%.

findings.finding: US hot-rolled coil rose steadily through WS's fiscal Q1 (Jun-Aug 2026): SMU average $1,115/st on 9 June, $1,145 on 23 June, $1,160 on 7 July, $1,165 on 21 July, $1,180 on 4 Aug and $1,195 on 18 Aug. Nucor's CSP paused at $1,130 for three weeks from 22 June, then rose again. Against that path WS guided pre-tax inventory holding gains of $10-15m for Q1 FY27 on the June call; the steady rise supports the top half of that range and gives Kloeckner's US arm similar holding gains.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q4 FY26 carried a $14.7m holding gain inside a $0.75 adjusted EPS, and the stock fell 7.04% on that print. Holding gains have not been rewarded on their own.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced. The price path is public and the company guided the gain. The open question is only top versus bottom of a $10-15m range, roughly $0.05/share. If the market had priced it the holding gain would be irrelevant to the bar, and it largely is. It lands inside guidance.
findings.independence: SMU weekly assessments as reported by gmk.center (https://gmk.center/en/news/nucor-is-raising-the-price-of-hot-rolled-coils-by-10-t/, 2026-07-28) and steelmarketupdate.com (https://www.steelmarketupdate.com/2026/08/24/nucor-hikes-spot-hr-price-by-10-ton-2/). Guidance quote: https://earningswhispers.com/transcript/WS/Q42026.

findings.finding: Kloeckner, now consolidated, printed Q2 2026 EBITDA before special effects of EUR 63m on 5 August (Americas EUR 42m, Europe EUR 20m, up from EUR -2m a year earlier). It said 'Q3 2026 started strong, in line with Q2', and US HRC was cited at ~$1,230 against ~$890 a year before. That is a ~EUR 60m/quarter run-rate for the June-August months WS consolidates, against the ~EUR 43m/quarter (2025 Q2-Q4: 65/43/21) inside the pro forma the street can see. The gap is roughly EUR 17m/quarter of extra EBITDA, about +$0.15-0.20/share to WS after tax and the 38% minority.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No history: this is the first quarter Kloeckner is consolidated. WS's own prints have been sold (6 of 7 down), so the size is held well under the median reaction.
findings.why_not_priced: Kloeckner reported in German euros on a Frankfurt listing that was delisted on 2026-08-12, and US aggregators have not folded it into WS: both consensus revenue figures ($886m/$950m) exclude it. If the US market had priced the run-rate, consensus revenue would sit near $2.8bn and the EPS bars would agree with each other. They do not. A '+10% in 5 days' tape may be part of it.
findings.independence: Quartr summary of the Q2 call quoting 'Q3 2026 started strong, in line with Q2' (https://quartr.com/events/kl-ckner-co-kco-q2-2026_oqzSLRx6). Kloeckner press release (https://www.kloeckner.com/en/media/press-releases/q2-2026/). Same company source, so not independent of each other.

findings.finding: WS's own unaudited pro forma (8-K/A, filed 2026-08-19) puts combined diluted EPS for the nine months to 28 Feb 2026 at $0.56, about $0.19/quarter on 50.7m shares. Standalone WS earned $70.9m (~$1.40/share) over the same months. Pro forma net interest is $121.0m for nine months, with ~$124m/yr of incremental interest on the $700m 7.75% notes plus the $700m SOFR+400 term loan, and 38% of Kloeckner's earnings goes to minorities. Even after adding Kloeckner's better 2026 run-rate, combined EPS is hard to bring near the $1.16 Zacks/Earnings Whispers bar, and $0.70 is the most it reaches. The first consolidated GAAP line will also carry purchase-accounting inventory step-up and deal costs.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q4 FY26 printed a GAAP loss (impairments and bridge costs) and fell 7.04%. Q3 FY26 fell 14.91%. Headline EPS shortfalls have been punished on this name.
findings.why_not_priced: The pro forma sits in a 490kB exhibit to an 8-K/A. The aggregator bars visibly do not reflect it: $1.16 on $885.9m of revenue is a standalone number. If the market had priced the dilution the EPS bars would sit near the pro forma run-rate and revenue would include Kloeckner. The three covering analysts' own models may already reflect it, which is why the size is capped.
findings.independence: The 10-K confirms the $700m notes at 7.750% and the $700m term loan at SOFR+4.00% (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001968487/000196848726000026/ws-20260531.htm). The same filing family, so partly the same document.

findings.finding: On 2026-07-10, 16 days after the 24 June release, WS filed an 8-K/A correcting its Q4 FY26 earnings release for 'additional long-lived asset impairment charges' in Electrical Steel and 'additional Bridge nonrevolving loan commitment costs'. The corrected operating loss is $74.5m, against the $57.6m first reported. A company that re-cut its own release in its last quarter now publishes its first, more complex consolidated quarter.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior instance. The Q4 print itself fell 7.04%.
findings.why_not_priced: It is a quiet 8-K/A, and the sweep row and wire summaries still quote the original $57.6m. It matters only if the Q1 release or 10-Q adds a control finding, which I could not confirm. Item 9A of the 10-K was not readable here.

findings.finding: On the June call management said it would 'provide additional color on the combined Worthington and Kloeckner company next quarter and expect to report combined results'. It reaffirmed $150m of EBITDA synergies, 50/50 over years 1-2, and a target to halve debt. So this print carries the first combined framework, which may be a new reporting segmentation, synergy tracking or a deleveraging path. Kloeckner's standalone FY2026 guide is EUR 170-250m EBITDA, with H1 at EUR 109m.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No combined guide has ever been given. WS does not give numeric EPS guidance, and its outlook has historically been qualitative plus a holding-gain range.
findings.why_not_priced: The content is unknown until the call, so the sign cannot be priced. Filed at zero as the reason abs_move_pct sits above the median.

findings.finding: S&P Global Mobility raised its 2026 North American light-vehicle production forecast by 66,000 units (+0.4%) to 15.06m, on stronger output through June. It also builds in a slowdown from Q4 2026 through H1 2027, with Detroit-3 full-size pickup inventory at 77 days at end-June. That means steady automotive volume in WS's Jun-Aug quarter, its largest end market, and a softer forward tone for Q2-Q3 FY27 commentary.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Not established. Management said on the June call that automotive should 'remain steady'.
findings.why_not_priced: This is an industry proxy and not company-confirmed. The slowdown is a published forecast, so it is likely known to holders. Sized small for that reason.

findings.finding: On 2026-09-17 the mills guided Q3 2026 up. Nucor guided EPS of $5.55-5.65 against $5.04 in Q2, on 'higher average selling prices and stable volumes', with its downstream steel products segment up on volume and price. Steel Dynamics guided $5.34-5.38 on record shipments and metal-margin expansion. Rising prices and firm demand through the summer support service-center spreads and volumes.
findings.why_not_priced: Probably priced. It is public, and steel equities likely moved on it, which may explain part of WS's +10% into the print. Mill strength can also squeeze a processor's spread on contract business.

findings.finding: Ryerson, the closest US service-center peer, guided Q3 2026 (Jul-Sep) on 29 July: shipments down 3-5% sequentially, selling prices flat to +2%, and adjusted EBITDA ex-LIFO of $88-92m against $101.0m in Q2. Its Q2 gross margin ex-LIFO and purchase accounting was 19.3%. That is a seasonal sequential softening in service-center volume across most of WS's Jun-Aug quarter.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Not established for WS. WS's fiscal Q1 is seasonally a summer quarter.
findings.why_not_priced: A peer proxy, public since July. The decline is largely seasonal and likely in models. Sized small.

findings.finding: WS rose 10.1% in the 5 sessions into the print, from about $35.6 to $39.24 (5.47% in late September per AAII). No company catalyst was found, and an AAII note of 2026-10-06 also identifies none. This is a name where 6 of the last 7 prints fell, including the -7.04% on a print Earnings Whispers scored as a beat.
findings.why_not_priced: Run-up and reaction history are public and partly priced by definition. An unexplained run-up is weak evidence, and it may reflect sector strength (the Nucor/STLD guides). Sized small.
findings.independence: Sealed baseline history (8-K item 2.02 acceptance times). Short interest rose 10% to 3.56% of float by 2026-09-15 (https://www.marketbeat.com/stocks/NYSE/WS/short-interest/).

findings.finding: Tempel Canada opened its $85m transformer-core expansion in Burlington, Ontario on 24 June 2026: 250,000 sq ft, more than 60% of the new capacity already contracted, incremental revenue expected from spring. Electrical Steel took $112m of impairments in Q4 FY26 on motor and auto weakness, so any transformer-led stabilisation is the upside for the forward tone on that unit.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Electrical Steel impairments featured in both of the last two down prints (-14.91 and -7.04).
findings.why_not_priced: Public, and the revenue is a spring 2027 item. It matters only as commentary, so it is sized near zero.

outside_window.finding: The Kloeckner EGM on 23 October 2026 votes on the domination and profit-and-loss-transfer agreement, which needs 75% of share capital. If approved it takes effect on registration, at the earliest 1 January 2027, and brings minority compensation payments and cash-pooling access to Kloeckner's balance sheet.

searched_and_found_nothing: Item 9A of the FY2026 10-K (material weakness after the 8-K/A correction): the main document returned stopped at Item 5; financial statements and controls appear to be in an exhibit, which I did not locate. No search hit for a WS material weakness.
A current short-interest figure beyond MarketBeat's 2026-09-15 settlement; Fintel's figure is undated.
Covering analysts' (KeyBanc and others) Q1 FY27 combined estimates: not public. The only published estimates are aggregator bars that exclude Kloeckner revenue.
Kloeckner trading after 5 August: the listing ended 2026-08-12, and no Q3 update or Becker sale closing was found.
Insider Form 4 activity since June: only performance-share vestings on 2026-07-07 (CEO, Executive Chairman). No open-market buys or sells after the January director purchases.
A catalyst for the +10% 5-day run-up: none found in company 8-Ks (the last was the 2026-09-24 item 5.07 annual meeting vote) or in news.
Usable option-implied move or skew: the chain is unusable (OI 121, spread 100% of mid).

rejected_candidates.detail: The page is dated 2026-03-18 and its 'current quarter' is fiscal Q3 FY26, not Q1 FY27. Misdated against the event.

rejected_candidates.detail: Folded into the bar discussion and the pro forma finding: it explains why the $1.16 Zacks bar is high, and is not separate evidence.

rejected_candidates.candidate: Kloeckner Becker Group write-down (EUR 151m in Q2 2026; EUR 218m total against a EUR 73m preliminary price)
rejected_candidates.detail: Taken in Kloeckner's books before WS consolidated it on 2026-06-03. WS's purchase accounting resets the asset to fair value, so it does not land in WS's Q1 P&L. The EUR 171m material special effects on the Q2 slide are pre-acquisition.

rejected_candidates.candidate: Debt financing of $1.4bn (7.75% notes plus SOFR+400 term loan) as a negative
rejected_candidates.detail: The money bought Kloeckner. Its interest cost is already counted inside the pro forma dilution finding, so it is not filed again as financing.

baseline_tension: There is no skew to agree or disagree with. The lean is negative, with the 6-of-7-down reaction history and the pro forma dilution. It cuts against the +10% run-up and Kloeckner's strong run-rate, so p_up sits only 5 points below 50.
lessons_applied: Rule 6 (bar disputed: $1.16 against $0.70, neither including Kloeckner revenue): capped every finding small. The pro forma dilution finding went from -1.2 to -0.8.
Rules 1 and 6 (a name that sells prints; a gain inside the guided $10-15m range): the HRC holding-gain finding went from +0.5 to +0.2, and the Kloeckner run-rate from +0.8 to +0.5.

Rule 5 (an unexplained move is not a cause; proxies are filed small): the run-up/positioning finding went from -0.7 to -0.3, Ryerson from -0.3 to -0.2, Nucor/STLD from +0.2 to +0.1, and S&P auto from -0.3 to -0.2.
Rule 2 (other/one-off with no path to the guide): the 8-K/A correction went from -0.3 to -0.2.
Rule 4 (financing is a question): the $1.4bn debt is not filed as a negative; its interest is already inside the pro forma finding.
Rule 8 and the core (first combined quarter, thin coverage): abs_move_pct held at 8.0, above the 6.87% median. p_up moved from 44 to 45 because the bar is disputed.
